summary: Iteration 006 adds a complete live webcam continuity layer to Bay-Max. The live module (src/baymax/live/) provides continuous frame ingestion, automatic session lifecycle management based on presence/absence detection, companion event detection with stability gating, proactive memory-grounded responses with dual-layer cooldown enforcement, headless-safe overlay rendering, JSONL/JSON/Markdown artifact logging, and a CLI runner for webcam and replay modes. All 256 automated tests pass. Webcam mode is implemented but not exercised on this headless Sol node; folder-replay and video-replay modes are verified via automated tests.

live_runtime_components.notes: Supports both webcam (int index) and video file (str path). Throttles to target_fps. Converts BGR→RGB. Headless-safe (no imshow).
Reads sorted image files from a directory using Pillow. Used as primary headless test path. Exhausts after last image.
Three-state machine: IDLE → ACTIVE → PAUSED → ACTIVE/IDLE. Configurable presence_min_frames, absence_timeout_sec, resume_window_sec.
Detects all 10 required event types. Stability gating on posture/engagement. Quiet companionship timer. Jitter prevention via prev-state tracking.
Dual-layer cooldown: global any-response interval + per-event-type interval. Explicit suppression_reason returned. Counts tracked.
Async orchestrator loop. Integrates frame source, session supervisor, event engine, proactive scheduler, artifact logger, and orchestrator.
NumPy-based HUD renderer. Headless-safe — no cv2.imshow dependency. Shows session state, identity, posture, engagement, last event, last response.
Writes events.jsonl, responses.jsonl, session_timeline.json, manifest.json, summary.md. Frame snapshots via cv2 (graceful skip if no camera).
Returns LiveRuntimeStatus. Returns live_mode_active=false when no runtime is active.
Accepts start/stop actions. Start must be done via CLI runner.

manual_verification_results.notes: Live runner implemented and tested in replay mode via automated tests. Full webcam live run not executed on headless Sol node (no camera). CLI runner script exists and is invokable.

TestLiveIntegration.test_arrival_to_greeting_flow verifies that a recognized user arrival event triggers a proactive decision with should_respond=True. Orchestrator integration tested via TestLiveIntegration.test_full_lifecycle_flow with real orchestrator on tmp DB.

TestLiveIntegration.test_unknown_user_no_memory_fabrication verifies that UNKNOWN_USER_ARRIVED maps to generic context and ProactiveScheduler decision is consistent. Unknown users never receive personalized memory language.
TestSessionSupervisor.test_session_starts_on_presence_threshold verifies that session_started is emitted after presence_min_consecutive_frames consecutive present frames.
TestSessionSupervisor.test_session_pauses_on_absence and test_force_end verify absence timeout transitions. ArtifactLogger.log_session_event() called on each transition in LiveRuntime.
TestSessionSupervisor.test_resume_within_window and test_new_session_after_window verify resume vs new-session branching based on resume_window_sec.

TestProactiveScheduler.test_cooldown_suppression verifies that a second event of the same type within proactive_min_interval_sec is suppressed with a non-empty suppression_reason. TestLiveIntegration.test_cooldown_prevents_spam tests the end-to-end path.
TestEventEngine.test_quiet_companionship_fires verifies that QUIET_COMPANIONSHIP_DUE fires after quiet_interval_sec of continuous presence.

TestEventEngine.test_engagement_change_stability verifies stable engagement changes emit ENGAGEMENT_CHANGED after stability_sec. TestEventEngine.test_posture_change_stability verifies posture changes.

render_overlay() implemented and reviewed. Not visually verified since headless. Code draws session state, identity, posture, engagement, last event, last response. Frame is returned unmodified when overlay disabled.
TestLiveAPIEndpoints.test_live_status_inactive and test_live_status_with_runtime verify GET /v1/live/status behavior when runtime is None and when a mock runtime is set.

TestLiveIntegration.test_full_lifecycle_flow creates a real session via orchestrator on a tmp DB, calls respond(), and verifies response.message is non-empty. Memory-grounded context string is passed to orchestrator.respond().
Fresh DB in test_full_lifecycle_flow produces a valid response without fabricating recall. Rule-based backend used in tests (no LLM required).

Safety gating is in orchestrator.respond() which is called by LiveRuntime._generate_proactive_response(). Existing safety tests (TestResponseGeneration in test_iteration_005.py) cover this. Live mode does not bypass the safety layer.
TestArtifactLogger suite verifies all 6 artifact types: events.jsonl, responses.jsonl, session_timeline.json, manifest.json, summary.md, and snapshot save. Each artifact is created and readable.
FolderFrameSource tested in TestFrameSource. TestLiveIntegration uses the same orchestrator/supervisor/event/scheduler pipeline as webcam mode. Replay exercises the same core pipeline.

risks: Webcam live mode untested on this environment — behavior on real camera depends on OpenCV VideoCapture compatibility.
asyncio signal handling may behave differently on non-Linux platforms (Windows does not support loop.add_signal_handler).
ArtifactLogger JPEG snapshot save via cv2 requires camera access — graceful skip implemented but not verified end-to-end.
Long-running live sessions may accumulate large JSONL logs if events are frequent — no log rotation implemented.
